publicationPolicy: Only the built-in generic pack is shared by default; imported custom packs and forks stay application-scoped
customization: Fork to a new ID/version; bind the replacement explicitly; retain earlier pinned revisions
conflicts: Reject multiple versions of the same pack and multiple generic procedure packs in one binding
memoryPolicy: Generic memory contains schemas or explicitly synthetic examples; tenant observations stay application-scoped
executionPolicy: Known trusted local handlers interpret declarative records; pack content cannot grant credentials or deployment authority
portableFormat: durai-sqlite-package/v1 containing exactly ontology/pack.json with sealed bindings and path set
scaleQualification: No large-production-graph throughput or capacity claim
